title: Snap-on Cable Sleeve
description: A short, split-tube circuit marker that snaps sideways onto a 2.5 mm² cable, standardized with a recessed 90° circumferential code path.

assets.label: 90° standard
assets.alt: Orange split-tube cable markers with L1P2 and L2P1 running circumferentially around the sleeves
assets.caption: Proposed standard — the code path is rotated 90° and travels around the sleeve, perpendicular to the cable axis.

assets.label: Axial comparison
assets.alt: Orange split-tube cable markers with recessed landscape codes L1P2 and L2P1
assets.caption: Comparison — the code runs along the cable axis and has less room for longer identifiers.
